derivation.equality: Every full return is guarded by native normalized reference equality, which entails E and V under the supplied canonical reference assumption.
derivation.token_only: Every full return has exact True or False, proving V. Candidate False with reference True reaches full return and violates E.
derivation.truthiness: Candidate False with reference True reaches full return and violates E; candidate banana with reference True reaches full return and violates V.

U_policy: No justified expressible obligation. null is an administrative abstention; it has no binary static bug label and never counts as TN.
origin: Analytical predictions from the three inspected source definitions and designed formal policies; not analyzer-generated labels. Native probes can validate witnesses but cannot prove safety.
one_sided_scope: Only necessary full-credit implications, not biconditional reward correctness. Equality under V and token_only under normalized format may under-reward valid submissions, which is outside this audit.
